# gravitino_job_template Resource



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gravitino_job_template" "etl" {
  metalake = gravitino_metalake.example.name
  name     = "daily_etl"
  template = "spark"
  parameters = {
    "main_class" = "com.example.ETLJob"
    "jar"        = "s3://jars/etl-job.jar"
    "args"       = "--date=${date}"
  }
  comment = "Daily ETL job template"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `name` (String) The job template name.
- `template` (String) The template definition.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) A comment or description for the job template.
- `parameters` (Map of String) A map of key-value parameters for the job template.
- `properties` (Map of String) A map of key-value properties for the job template.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Object) Audit information for the job template. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format 'metalake.template_name'.
